Common AC Error Codes & Solutions

Voltas / Carrier / Daikin

  • E1/E2: Room sensor failure. Requires replacement.
  • E5/E6: Communication error between indoor and outdoor units. Wiring check needed.
  • EC: Refrigerant leak detection. AC gas refilling price Vadodara 2024 applies.
  • F1/F2: Outdoor condenser sensor fault.

LG / Samsung / Panasonic

  • CH 05 / E4: Communication signal error. Check PCB.
  • CH 38: Low refrigerant level. Needs leak testing.
  • C9: Outdoor fan motor malfunction.
  • H6: Indoor fan motor error.

Error codes vary by model. If you see these codes, switch off your AC immediately and call our AC service center Vadodara at +91 97272 57141.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does AC service cost in Vadodara?
The standard AC service charges in Vadodara start from ₹499 for window ACs and ₹599 for split ACs. Deep cleaning and jet pump services generally cost between ₹999 to ₹1299.
Why is my AC making noise? What is the repair cost?
Noise issues usually stem from a loose fan blade, debris in the unit, or a worn-out motor bearing. Repair costs range from ₹350 for minor adjustments to ₹2500 for motor replacements.
What is the price for AC gas refilling in Baroda?
For R32 or R410A gas, full charging typically costs between ₹2400 to ₹2800 for a 1.5-ton split AC. Top-up charges are lower, usually around ₹1200-₹1500.
Which AC service is open on Sunday in Vadodara?
Atlas Aircon offers Weekend AC service Vadodara. We are open on Sundays to ensure you don’t suffer in the heat on your day off.
Do you provide service in GIDC areas like Makarpura?
Yes, we specialize in industrial cooling. We cover Makarpura GIDC, Nandesari, Waghodia, Por, and Savli GIDC with dedicated teams for panel ACs, chillers, and ductable units.
What is the difference between normal service and deep cleaning?
Normal service involves cleaning filters and basic dusting of the outdoor unit. Deep cleaning uses a pressure pump (Jet Pump) to remove stubborn dirt from the cooling coils, drain tray, and blower, significantly improving cooling efficiency.
Do you offer a warranty on repairs?
Yes, we offer a warranty on spare parts replaced by us (typically 3 to 6 months depending on the part) and a service guarantee on gas charging.
How often should I service my AC in Vadodara?
Given Vadodara’s dusty and humid climate, we recommend servicing your AC at least twice a year: once before summer starts (Feb-March) and once after the monsoon (Oct-Nov) to prevent corrosion.
Do you repair old or second-hand ACs?
Yes, we repair all models regardless of age. We also buy and sell used/second-hand air conditioners and handle scrap ACs.
Are there any visiting charges?
There is a nominal inspection charge of ₹200-₹300. However, if you choose to proceed with the repair service with us, this visiting charge is waived off/adjusted in the final bill.
